d:
Enjoy this hit classic sensuous Hindi Song sung by Asha Bhosle from the superhit Bollywood blockbuster romantic comedy family drama movie 'Pati Patni' (1966). Music composed by R.D. Burman. Lyrics by Anand Bakshi. Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Nanda, Mehmood, Mumtaz, Sujit Kumar, Shashikala, Om Prakash, Johnny Walker, Leela Mishra. Directed by S.A. Akbar.
Credits:-
Movie: Pati Patni (1966)
Singers: Asha Bhosle
Music: R.D. Burman
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Nanda, Mumtaz, Mehmood and Jhonny Walker
Director: S.A. Akbar
